text: County seeks an annual actuarial valuation of its self-insured workers compensation program, including a three-year forecast in each annual report

citations.text: The County of Ulster is currently seeking proposals for actuarial services for the Ulster County Self-Insurance Plan which includes County Government, local municipalities, school districts, and volunteer fire fighters.
The County is seeking a qualified Actuary Firm to provide an annual actuarial valuation of the County’s self-insured workers compensation program.
Each year, the awarded vendor will produce a report containing a three-year forecast.
